findings.explanation: Order MLB-030018 (toys, premium): gross 5114.31 BRL. Expected commission at 17% = 869.43 BRL (calculated as round_half_up(5114.31 * 0.17)). Observed commission in settlement: 969.16 BRL. Overcharge: 969.16 - 869.43 = 99.73 BRL.

Total observed gross: 129.48 BRL (exactly double). This is a complete duplicate of the settlement row. Expected net: 48.13, observed net: 96.26. Duplicate impact: 48.13 BRL.

Settlement row ST-0400068 (gross=214.15, fee=-27.84, net=186.31) exists in the settlement statement but order MLB-049648 is not present in the seller's order book. This is an orphan settlement row with no corresponding order. The seller received 186.31 BRL for an order that does not exist in their records.

Seller received 1026.18 BRL instead of -39.90 BRL, an excess of 1066.08 BRL (will face clawback).

Order delivered with gross 909.36 BRL (premium/home = 17% commission = 154.59 BRL, heavy shipping = 39.90 BRL). Expected payment row with net 714.87 BRL. Zero settlement rows observed. Seller received 0.00 BRL instead of 714.87 BRL.
